text:
Meera, Kavya Rao ka office order (31 Oct): 4 Diwali hamper + 3 box chocolate truffle.

2 dikkat hain:
1. Whitefield humare delivery area mein nahi hai, wahan sirf Indiranagar se pickup ho sakta hai.
2. 20% discount menu mein nahi hai, main nahi de sakta. Yeh tumhara decision hai.

Pickup ke saath total Rs 7,436, 50% advance Rs 3,718 abhi, baaki Rs 3,718 baad mein. Oven mein jagah hai.

Customer ko yeh reply bhej sakte hain:
"Hi Kavya! Order ke liye thanks 😊 Whitefield hamare delivery area mein nahi hai, toh Indiranagar se pickup karna hoga. Total Rs 7,436, advance Rs 3,718. Discount abhi possible nahi hai, par hum order ache se pack karenge. Pickup chalega?"

Bolo toh bhej deta hoon, ya pickup confirm hone par link bhej dunga.

Meera, Kavya ka order abhi nahi bheja. Isme do dikkat hain.

- **Delivery:** Whitefield humare delivery area mein nahi hai. Wahan sirf Indiranagar se pickup ho sakta hai.
- **Discount:** Kavya ne 20% off maanga hai, par menu mein discount nahi hai. Main discount nahi de sakta. Dena hai ya nahi, yeh tumhara decision hai.

Pickup ke saath 4 Diwali hamper aur 3 box chocolate truffle ka total Rs 7,436 hai. Advance Rs 3,718 abhi lagega aur baaki Rs 3,718 baad mein. 31 Oct ko oven mein jagah hai.

Maine tumhe Kavya ke liye ek reply likh kar bheja hai. Usme pickup, total aur advance hai, aur discount ke liye na hai. Tum bolo to wahi bhej deta hoon. Ya Kavya pickup ke liye haan kar de to seedha payment link bhej dunga.
